collate_samples_for_speech_recognition: collate speech recognition samples into a padded batch with source frames and target tokens
collate_frames_into_padded_tensor: collate a list of 2d feature frames into a padded 3d tensor for batch processing
create_seq2seq_collater: create a Seq2SeqCollater instance with custom feature index, label index, pad index, and eos index
parse_samples_into_tensors: parse raw samples with numpy arrays and lists into torch tensors for batch collation
sort_samples_by_frame_length: sort collated samples by descending frame length and reorder ids, frames, and targets accordingly
